```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 8,
                      fig.height = 4, dpi = 120, message = FALSE)
```

Catch projections from the JABBA posterior. Each MCMC draw is projected under
each constant catch with `projectJabba()` (a wrapper for `JABBA::fw_jabba`),
and every summary is **empirical**: intervals are posterior quantiles and Kobe
probabilities are proportions of draws. The last section compares these with
probabilities from a bivariate log-normal fitted to the same draws, which is
how far a moment-based summary would be wrong for this posterior.

Set `FLREBUILD_JABBADIR` to a folder of `SMA2026_<run>_jabba.rdata` fits
(saved with `save.trj = TRUE`) and `FLREBUILD_JABBARUN` to the run to
project. The defaults are the 2026 North Atlantic shortfin mako runs.

```{r setup}
library(FLRebuild)
library(ggplot2)

jabbaDir=Sys.getenv("FLREBUILD_JABBADIR", unset = paste0(
  "P:/rfmo/iccat/2026/SHK/Analysis/final assessment results/",
  "JABBA/final3JABBA/outputCorrected"))
jabbaRun=Sys.getenv("FLREBUILD_JABBARUN", unset = "1-S")
jabbaRuns=c("1-B", "1-S", "2-S")
fitFile=function(r) file.path(jabbaDir, paste0("SMA2026_", r, "_jabba.rdata"))
jabbaExists=requireNamespace("JABBA", quietly = TRUE) && file.exists(fitFile(jabbaRun))
hasKobe=requireNamespace("kobe", quietly = TRUE)

annYrs =2025:2070
k2Yrs  =c(2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2035, 2040, 2045, 2050, 2055, 2060, 2065, 2070)
densYrs=c(2026, 2028, 2030, 2050, 2070)
tacsFig=c(0, 250, 1200, 1883, 2300)
tacs   =seq(0, 2300, by = 100)
```

```{r load, eval=jabbaExists}
fits=lapply(setNames(jabbaRuns, jabbaRuns), function(r)
  if (file.exists(fitFile(r)))
    getRuns(setNames(localCopy(fitFile(r)), r), source = "jabba")[[r]])
fits=Filter(Negate(is.null), fits)
fit =fits[[jabbaRun]]
termYr=max(fit$kbtrj$year, na.rm = TRUE)
prj=projectJabba(fit, catch = tacs, nyears = max(annYrs) - termYr,
                 imp.yr = 3, thin = 10, prjOnly = TRUE)
prj=prj[prj$year %in% annYrs, ]
prob=kobeEmpirical(prj)
```

# Assessment runs

Posterior median and 95% interval of \(B/B_{MSY}\) and \(F/F_{MSY}\) for each
run.

```{r runs, eval=jabbaExists, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="B/BMSY and F/FMSY by JABBA run: posterior median and 95% interval."}
ci=do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(r)
  kobeCI(jabbaKbtrj(fits[[r]], yearMax = termYr), 0.95, paste("JABBA", r))))
plotKobeCI(ci, colour = "method", facets = quant ~ .)
```

# Trajectories

History of run `r jabbaRun` followed by the projection for each catch.

```{r traj, eval=jabbaExists, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="B/BMSY and F/FMSY by catch: posterior median and 50/80/95% intervals. Dotted line: last assessment year."}
hist=jabbaKbtrj(fit, yearMax = termYr)[, c("iter", "year", "stock", "harvest")]
trj=rbind(do.call(rbind, lapply(tacsFig, function(c0) cbind(hist, catch = c0))),
          prj[prj$catch %in% tacsFig, c("iter", "year", "stock", "harvest", "catch")])
plotKobeCI(kobeCI(trj), vline = termYr + 0.5)
```

# Kobe II strategy matrix

```{r k2sm, eval=jabbaExists, fig.height=12, fig.width=6, fig.cap="Kobe II strategy matrix: proportion of posterior draws with F <= FMSY, B >= BMSY and in the green quadrant."}
plotK2SM(k2smLong(prob, years = k2Yrs))
```

# Densities

```{r dens, eval=jabbaExists, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Posterior densities of B/BMSY and F/FMSY by year and catch. Zero F is omitted."}
d=prj[prj$catch %in% tacsFig & prj$year %in% densYrs, ]
dl=rbind(data.frame(d[, c("catch", "year")], quant = "B/BMSY", x = d$stock),
         data.frame(d[, c("catch", "year")], quant = "F/FMSY", x = d$harvest))
ggplot(dl[is.finite(dl$x) & dl$x > 1e-8, ], aes(x, colour = factor(catch))) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(quant ~ year, scales = "free") + scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density", colour = "Catch (t)") + theme_kobe()
```

# Phase plot

```{r phase, eval=jabbaExists && hasKobe, fig.height=6, fig.width=6, fig.cap="Kobe phase plot in 2070: posterior draws for selected catches."}
ph=kobeSample(prj[prj$year == 2070 & prj$catch %in% tacsFig, ], n = 800, seed = 2070)
ph$run=factor(ph$catch, tacsFig)
kobe:::kobePhaseMar2(ph[, c("stock", "harvest", "run")],
                     xlab = expression(B / B[MSY]), ylab = expression(F / F[MSY]))
```

# Recovery curve

Last year in which the proportion of draws in the green quadrant crosses 0.6
or 0.7, for each catch run (`kobeRebuildCurveEmpirical()`).

```{r rebuild, eval=jabbaExists, fig.height=3.5, fig.cap="Recovery year against catch for target P(green) of 0.6 and 0.7."}
curve=kobeRebuildCurveEmpirical(prob, target = c(0.6, 0.7))
ggplot(curve, aes(catch, rebuildYear, colour = factor(target))) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  labs(x = "Catch (t)", y = "Recovery year", colour = "P(green)") + theme_kobe()
```

# Catch meeting a target

```{r target, eval=jabbaExists}
tt=expand.grid(year = c(2045, 2070), target = c(0.6, 0.7))
tt$catch=mapply(function(y, t) kobeTargetCatchEmpirical(prob, y, t),
                tt$year, tt$target)
knitr::kable(tt, digits = 0, caption = "Catch (t) at which P(green) equals the target.")
```

# Moments against draws

A bivariate log-normal fitted to the draws (`kobeMomentGridJabba()`) gives
moment-based probabilities. Their difference from the proportions of draws is
the error of the log-normal approximation for this posterior.

```{r approx, eval=jabbaExists, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=4.5, fig.cap="P(green) from log-normal moments against the proportion of draws, all catches and years."}
mom=makeK2SM(kobeMomentGridJabba(prj, years = annYrs), years = annYrs)$long
mom$catch=as.numeric(mom$catch)
me=merge(mom[, c("catch", "year", "green")], prob[, c("catch", "year", "green")],
         by = c("catch", "year"), suffixes = c("Moment", "Draws"))
ggplot(me, aes(greenDraws, greenMoment)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, colour = "#d95f02") + coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "P(green), draws", y = "P(green), moments") + theme_kobe()
```

The mean and maximum absolute differences are
`r if (jabbaExists) sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", 100 * mean(abs(me$greenMoment - me$greenDraws)), 100 * max(abs(me$greenMoment - me$greenDraws))) else "n/a"`
percentage points.

```{r status, echo=FALSE}
if (!jabbaExists) message("JABBA or the fit at ", jabbaDir, " not found; chunks skipped.")
```
